device.description: 12-bit 2-channel 200-500 kSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: adc122s051.pdf (SNAS257E) p.1 connection diagram, p.2 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.5 output coding, p.6 timing specifications, p.7 serial timing diagram, p.17-18 serial interface and control register (Tables 2-4)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: Control Register bits 5:3 (ADD2-ADD0); internal, no address

commands.name: Control Register
commands.note: DIN on the first 8 rising SCLK edges of each 16-SCLK conversion; selects the input for the next conversion

pages: p.1 (pinout: CS1 VA2 GND3 IN2 4 IN1 5 DIN6 DOUT7 SCLK8), p.2 (pin descriptions), p.3 (operating ratings: VA 2.7-5.25 V, digital inputs -0.3 V to VA), p.5 (straight binary), p.6 (tEN 30 ns, tACC 30 ns, tDIS 20 ns), p.7 (serial timing diagram), p.17-18 (control register Tables 2-4)
notModeled: analog inputs (the result is the 0 V code 0x000 on both channels)

pipelined channel select: ADD2-ADD0 written during a conversion select the input of the NEXT conversion; the model stores them at once (the code is the same on every channel); first conversion after power-up is IN1 (reset 0)
ADD2 is don't care (codes 4/5 = IN1/IN2) and ADD1 = 1 gives an indeterminate output: CTRL.ADD values 2-7 are stored as written
conversion clocked by SCLK; several 16-SCLK conversions in one CS frame are modeled by the stream frame and the repeating output (idle "repeat")
SPI mode 3 chosen (SCLK may also be low at CS fall: the CS fall then counts as the first falling edge)
power-down while CS is high and between continuous conversions (no visible digital effect)
variants: ADC122S021 / ADC122S051 / ADC122S101 are pin and function compatible at 50-200 / 200-500 / 500-1000 kSPS; ADC082S/ADC102S are the 8/10-bit parts; ADC122S051Q is the automotive grade (QIMM parts)
